name: ProductList
description: Mortar product list: a responsive grid of product cards with image, name, variant, price and badge; the name link covers the card. Opt-in card variant with supporting text, colour swatches (consumer-supplied colours, announced by label) and a per-card action.

props.label: string
props.products: ProductCard[] ({ id: string; name: string; href: string; price: string; image: { src: string; alt: string }; meta?: string; badge?: string; description?: string; swatches?: { label: string; swatch: string }[]; action?: ReactNode })
props.variant: "plain" | "card" (default "plain"; card frames each product for full-detail listings)

contract.usage: Import { ProductList } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
